Ruling

Fee stands, driver compensated DRIVER_COMPENSATION

The fee stands. The driver is paid SGD 3.60. No refund.

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider: your $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands. To the driver: you are paid $3.60 of it, with $0.90 retained by the platform. The driver's arrival and wait are documented end to end. The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 21:26:22, and the GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius at that same second (closest fix 0.11 m from the pin). He then held position there without a break for 436 seconds — 45 qualifying in-radius fixes from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38 — against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). He terminated the trip at 21:33:39 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one second after that dwell completed. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold. None of the refund routes opens. POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) fails on arithmetic: the effective in-geofence dwell exceeds the 180 s minimum by 256 seconds, a surplus and not a shortfall. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not bite: the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no waiting clock is recomputed and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not in the band beyond it, and the record carries a single registered pickup point, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill could not arise either. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log's only message was sent by the driver ('im at the pickup point', 21:26:42, read 21:27:12), not by the rider, so limb (a) fails, and the rider's track sits roughly 798 m from the pin throughout — far outside the 100 m rider-presence radius — so limb (c) does not hold either. We record the rider's distance as context only and make no separate adverse finding about the rider from it: no clause makes rider position an element of the charge, and the rider is right that it is not one. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02728-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). It is not relied on by either side: the dwell is a single unbroken 436-second run, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation rule is never needed, and no advisory is required to excuse anything. Its absence is citable but neutral. On the money, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee in force under POL-NS-01, i.e. $3.60 of the $4.50, with the residual $0.90 retained as the platform service fee; that is the platform's net figure, and the rider's gross figure of $6.61 is deliberately not the payout base. The anti-farming check does not trip: the driver's trailing-30-day no-show terminations are 3, below the absolute limb of 4, and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075, not greater than 0.08, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Accordingly the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd ($3.60) — it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider. The waiting-time line is $0.00, so nothing is double-charged. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree (the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix match to the second, and the fare line reconciles exactly), and neither the counterparty-dispute counter nor the rider's 30-day no-show dispute counter reaches its threshold. The monetary effect of $3.60 is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling issues and executes automatically. No referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is true, and POL-NS-03 does not apply. The dispute is decided on the driver's arrival and dwell evidence, both at full weight (1.0), and no artifact relied on is impaired. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The rider's cleanest route to a refund — a waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06 — is closed on this record, and the rider does not seek a refund on that ground: the minimum in force for this trip is the 180 s free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, while the derived effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous run of 436 s made up of 45 in-radius fixes from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38 — a surplus of 256 s, not a shortfall. The cancellation came 437 s after the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix, so nothing in POL-NS-06 refunds the $4.50.

evidence EV-GPS-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The rider also does not allege a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05, because the derived arrival facts foreclose it: the dwell start offset from the driver's 21:26:22 'I'm Here' event is 0.0 s, so the first qualifying in-geofence fix and the arrival marker coincide and the driver cannot have been more than the arrival radius off the pin at the marker; a recomputed waiting clock under POL-NS-05 would begin at the identical fix and the corrected dwell would still be 436 s, which satisfies POL-NS-05(iii) rather than defeating the fee, leaving the outcome on POL-NS-01.

evidence EV-GPS-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-05, POL-NS-01

kept POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider and is not pressed: limb (a) requires a message sent by the rider during the waiting window, and the chat log contains exactly one message, which is the driver's ('im at the pickup point', sent 21:26:42, delivered 21:26:43, read 21:27:12), so there is no unanswered rider contact for the judge to weigh; and limb (c) fails on its own arithmetic in any event, because the rider's track contains 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius — its fixes sit roughly 798 m to 805 m from the pin for the whole window — so the rider cannot show presence at the pickup point.

evidence EV-CHAT-02728, EV-GPS-02728 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept No traffic advisory covers this pickup point, and the absence is itself citable: EV-ADVIS-02728-01 is MISSING, carries no payload, and has weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. The consequence for this case is that POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable to the driver — there is no advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT that would permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and no lawful-holding excuse — so the driver's position-holding must stand or fall on that single 436 s in-geofence interval, unaggregated and unexcused, and no part of the dwell may be supplemented by a document that does not exist.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02728-01 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept The rider's own location is not an element of the charge and should not be treated as one: POL-NS-01 limb (d) tests the absence of a boarding event, the driver's cancellation_reason_code and the time of termination against the elapsed dwell — not where the rider's device was — and the only clause in this category that tests rider position at all, POL-NS-04(c), is a clause a rider invokes to be exonerated, not a condition of the fee. The rider likewise accepts that the driver made a single in-app message and no voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), and notes only that no clause conditions the fee on any further contact attempt, so that fact is neutral rather than an admission. The rider asks the judge to decide the fee on the driver's documented arrival and dwell and to record the rider's distance from the pin as context, not as a separate adverse finding about the rider's conduct.

evidence EV-GPS-02728, EV-TRIP-02728, EV-CHAT-02728 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-04

evidence EV-GPS-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-05

evidence EV-GPS-02728 · clauses POL-NS-06

evidence EV-CHAT-02728, EV-GPS-02728 · clauses POL-NS-04

The rider never replied before the driver terminated the trip at 21:33:39, and the counterparty statement on file says 'Rider did not show after the waiting period.' evidence EV-CHAT-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept POL-NS-03 does not apply and yields no refund route. That clause governs stationary fixes OUTSIDE the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m STANDARD radius (minimum distance 0.11 m), so the wrong-entrance band is never entered. Independently, registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill of POL-NS-03(ii) — which requires 2 or more registered points — could not arise on these facts either.

evidence EV-GPS-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-03

kept The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. It requires BOTH limbs: no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND that count divided by completed_trips_30d greater than 0.08. The driver's trailing-30-day no-show terminations stand at 3 (below 4) and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075 (not greater than 0.08). This is the only profile test the clause permits, and it is passed.

evidence EV-DPROF-02728 · clauses POL-NS-07

kept The driver's payout is SGD 3.60 — 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in force for this trip, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. That is the net figure the platform's own money block computes from POL-NS-07 (driver_compensation '3.60'), and it is deliberately not the rider's gross figure of SGD 6.61.

evidence EV-FARE-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-07

kept The ruling on this case is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not a bare NO_ACTION. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full on limbs (a) through (d), no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-07 therefore fixes the driver's payout and requires the emitted ruling value to be DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd. The rider's charge of SGD 4.50 stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) with no refund.

evidence EV-FARE-02728, EV-TRIP-02728 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03

To the rider: your $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands. To the driver: you are paid $3.60 of it, with $0.90 retained by the platform. The driver's arrival and wait are documented end to end. The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 21:26:22, and the GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius at that same second (closest fix 0.11 m from the pin). He then held position there without a break for 436 seconds — 45 qualifying in-radius fixes from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38 — against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). He terminated the trip at 21:33:39 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one second after that dwell completed. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold. None of the refund routes opens. POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) fails on arithmetic: the effective in-geofence dwell exceeds the 180 s minimum by 256 seconds, a surplus and not a shortfall. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not bite: the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no waiting clock is recomputed and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not in the band beyond it, and the record carries a single registered pickup point, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill could not arise either. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log's only message was sent by the driver ('im at the pickup point', 21:26:42, read 21:27:12), not by the rider, so limb (a) fails, and the rider's track sits roughly 798 m from the pin throughout — far outside the 100 m rider-presence radius — so limb (c) does not hold either. We record the rider's distance as context only and make no separate adverse finding about the rider from it: no clause makes rider position an element of the charge, and the rider is right that it is not one. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02728-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). It is not relied on by either side: the dwell is a single unbroken 436-second run, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation rule is never needed, and no advisory is required to excuse anything. Its absence is citable but neutral. On the money, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee in force under POL-NS-01, i.e. $3.60 of the $4.50, with the residual $0.90 retained as the platform service fee; that is the platform's net figure, and the rider's gross figure of $6.61 is deliberately not the payout base. The anti-farming check does not trip: the driver's trailing-30-day no-show terminations are 3, below the absolute limb of 4, and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075, not greater than 0.08, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Accordingly the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd ($3.60) — it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider. The waiting-time line is $0.00, so nothing is double-charged. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree (the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix match to the second, and the fare line reconciles exactly), and neither the counterparty-dispute counter nor the rider's 30-day no-show dispute counter reaches its threshold. The monetary effect of $3.60 is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling issues and executes automatically. No referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is true, and POL-NS-03 does not apply. The dispute is decided on the driver's arrival and dwell evidence, both at full weight (1.0), and no artifact relied on is impaired.
